actual_execution_clv.applies_to: real owner-placed wagers with a verified pregame close
actual_execution_clv.definition: close midpoint - quantity-weighted exchange fill VWAP (fee-EXCLUSIVE); pre-fee; includes real slippage and spread; entry fees are NOT in the price

close_validity.definition: two-sided, uncrossed quote of the same ticker, observed strictly before the scheduled start, no older than 3600 s; settlement values, last trades and one-sided books are never closes

fee_adjusted_difference.definition: actual (or quoted) execution CLV - entry fee per contract; the entry fee is subtracted exactly once; no exit fee for positions held to settlement. Real wagers: exchange-reported fees. Shadow: a modelled schedule fee (never a fill)

independence.definition: uncertainty intervals are 95% percentile bootstraps resampling whole GAMES (clusters); many tickers, horizons and arms of one game are not independent observations

quoted_execution_clv.definition: close midpoint - contemporaneous executable ASK of the side; pre-fee; includes the entry half-spread

selection_clv.applies_to: hypothetical model-side selections (NFL shadow). Real wagers: unverifiable (no recommendation->order link)
selection_clv.definition: close midpoint - recommendation/horizon-time midpoint of the SAME side (YES/NO normalised); fee-exclusive and spread-exclusive; probability points (dollars per contract)
